milestones.title: Unified taxonomy for false discovery rate control in omics research
milestones.summary: A new 2x2 matrix taxonomy helps omics researchers select appropriate false discovery rate control procedures based on data type and study design.

milestones.title: De novo design of proteases
milestones.summary: Researchers achieve de novo design of functional proteases, a breakthrough in computational protein engineering and synthetic biology.

milestones.title: Cas12a combinatorial knockout screens map DNA damage response genetic architecture
milestones.summary: Cas12a-based combinatorial knockout screens create a comprehensive genetic interaction map of the DNA damage response, revealing functional relationships among DDR genes and pathways.

milestones.title: BrainBind: Synchronized EEG-fMRI Decoding for Naturalistic Video
milestones.summary: New framework BrainBind enables joint decoding of synchronized EEG and fMRI data during long-form naturalistic video viewing, bridging complementary temporal and spatial scales.

milestones.title: Engineered compact Cas12m variant enables multiplexed gene activation in vivo
milestones.summary: Researchers developed a compact Cas12m variant (smCRISPRa) enabling high-efficiency multiplexed gene activation in mouse models.

milestones.title: mRNA vaccine protects dairy cows from H5N1 influenza
milestones.summary: An mRNA-lipid nanoparticle vaccine successfully protects lactating dairy cows from H5N1 influenza infection, demonstrating a novel veterinary application of mRNA vaccine technology.

milestones.title: Malaria Parasite Invasion Mechanism Visualized at Molecular Resolution
milestones.summary: Researchers have visualized in fine detail the temporary molecular portal used by malaria parasites to invade red blood cells, revealing a novel entry mechanism.

milestones.title: Recordanelles enable multi-day recording of transient gene expression in single human cells
milestones.summary: Synthetic organelles called recordanelles can capture transient RNA changes in single human cells over several days with single-cell sensitivity.

milestones.title: Human AGO2-based programmable RNA editor ALTER avoids immune responses
milestones.summary: Researchers developed ALTER, a programmable RNA base editor using human Argonaute 2, reducing immune risks and outperforming dCas13 editors.

milestones.title: Human AGO2-based programmable RNA editor ALTER avoids immune responses
milestones.summary: ALTER uses human Argonaute 2 for programmable RNA editing, eliminating bacterial protein immunogenicity risks and outperforming dCas13 editors.

milestones.title: Recordanelles enable continuous transcriptome recording in human cells
milestones.summary: Recordanelles enable continuous, unbiased transcriptome-wide recording over time in living human cells, advancing single-cell temporal analysis.

milestones.title: Recordanelles enable continuous transcriptome-wide RNA recording in living human cells
milestones.summary: Recordanelles provide continuous, unbiased transcriptome-wide RNA recording across time in living mammalian cells, enabling dynamic single-cell transcriptomics.

milestones.title: DynaVelo deep learning model predicts B-cell perturbation responses from single-cell multiomic velocities
milestones.summary: A new deep dynamical model integrates single-cell multiomic data to infer cell state dynamics and accurately predict loss-of-function and rescue perturbations in B cells.

milestones.title: Plant-directed control of bacterial activity via genetic code expansion
milestones.summary: Researchers use noncanonical amino acid O-methyl-L-tyrosine to enable plants to control bacterial protein synthesis across diverse plant species.

milestones.title: Engineered human Argonaute 2 enables targeted C-to-U RNA base editing
milestones.summary: Researchers engineered human Argonaute 2 to perform targeted C-to-U RNA base editing, creating a potential therapeutic RNA editing tool using endogenous human proteins.

milestones.title: HitSV improves structural variant detection across sequencing technologies
milestones.summary: The HitSV model improves structural variant detection by modeling the interaction between genomic repetitiveness and signature intensity.

milestones.title: HitSV improves structural variant detection across sequencing technologies
milestones.summary: HitSV models genomic repetitiveness and signature intensity interactions to enhance structural variant detection accuracy across sequencing platforms.

milestones.title: In vivo engineering of CAR NK cells via ligand-directed lipid nanoparticles
milestones.summary: Researchers demonstrate in vivo generation of chimeric antigen receptor natural killer cells using ligand-directed lipid nanoparticles for treating autoimmune disease and cancer.

milestones.title: Proteomic aging clocks deployed in clinical trial for first time
milestones.summary: Six proteomic aging clocks used in a clinical trial for the first time, providing insights into clock performance rather than drug efficacy.

milestones.title: Engrafting human cortical organoids
milestones.summary: Researchers achieve successful engraftment of human cortical organoids, enabling advanced brain modeling and potential neural repair applications.

milestones.title: RevMed's pancreatic cancer drug first
milestones.summary: RevMed publishes first pancreatic cancer drug candidate in Nature Biotechnology.

milestones.title: Shotgun genetic engineering enables novel metabolic pathways in mammalian cells
milestones.summary: Shotgun genetic engineering allows large-scale random gene combination testing to discover new metabolic pathways for essential amino acid synthesis in mammalian cells.

milestones.title: Highly multiplexed mammalian metabolic engineering via shotgun screening
milestones.summary: A shotgun screening approach simplifies and scales metabolic engineering in mammalian cells.

milestones.title: Engineered avian R2 retrotransposons enable all-RNA targeted DNA integration in human cells
milestones.summary: Researchers engineered avian R2 retrotransposons to achieve site-specific DNA integration in human cells using an all-RNA system.

milestones.title: Engineered avian R2 retrotransposons enable targeted DNA integration in human cells
milestones.summary: Researchers engineered avian R2 retrotransposons to achieve site-specific DNA integration in human cells, a breakthrough for gene therapy.

milestones.title: Detectrons: RNA-to-DNA barcode conversion for high-throughput RNA analysis
milestones.summary: New Detectron technology enables direct conversion of transient RNA sequences into stable DNA barcodes for high-throughput analysis of RNA-dependent processes.

milestones.title: Deep learning perturbation models outperform baselines on calibrated metrics
milestones.summary: Calibration-aware evaluation demonstrates deep learning models surpass baseline methods in perturbation prediction.

milestones.title: AI-guided optimization yields thermostable mRNA vaccines stable at 37°C for 2 months
milestones.summary: AI-driven framework AGENT enables mRNA vaccines retaining full bioactivity after 2 months at 37°C, allowing cold-chain-free delivery via microneedle patches.

milestones.title: AI-guided optimization yields thermostable mRNA vaccines stable at 37°C for 2 months
milestones.summary: AI framework AGENT engineers mRNA vaccines retaining full bioactivity after 2 months at 37°C, enabling cold-chain-free microneedle patch delivery in primates.

milestones.title: AI-accelerated discovery of thermostable mRNA–LNP vaccines
milestones.summary: Data-efficient AI enables rapid identification of thermostable mRNA–lipid nanoparticle vaccine formulations, advancing vaccine stability and deployment.

milestones.title: Lipid nanoparticles optimized for large RNA cargo enhance in vivo genome editing
milestones.summary: Researchers improved lipid nanoparticle design by incorporating RNA cargo size, enabling better tissue targeting and enhanced in vivo genome editing.

milestones.title: LC-1 lipid nanoparticle enables efficient delivery of large gene editors in mice
milestones.summary: New ionizable lipid LC-1 improves endosomal escape and enables efficient genome editing in liver, lung, and brain of mice for large mRNA cargo.

milestones.title: Photolabile oligonucleotides enable spatially resolved single-cell transcriptomics and epigenomics
milestones.summary: A new photolabile oligonucleotide system uses topological light gradients to achieve spatially resolved single-cell measurements linking epigenome regulation to gene expression.

milestones.title: Alkermes reports pioneering ADHD data for orexin agonist
milestones.summary: Alkermes releases pioneering clinical data for orexin agonist in ADHD, potentially expanding the drug class beyond narcolepsy into broader patient populations.

milestones.title: Versatile nanopore sensor simultaneously identifies four analyte classes with 98.7% accuracy
milestones.summary: A modified bacterial porin nanopore coupled with machine learning simultaneously identifies amino acids, nucleoside monophosphates, saccharides, and peptides with 98.7% accuracy, enabling native glyco

milestones.title: Engineered nanopore simultaneously identifies saccharides, amino acids, peptides, and ribonucleotides
milestones.summary: A modified nanopore achieves simultaneous detection of four major biomolecule classes and their modifications, marking a breakthrough in multiplexed single-molecule sensing.

milestones.title: Biomimetic cells enable new platform for T cell mechanotransduction studies
milestones.summary: Researchers develop biomimetic cells as a novel synthetic biology tool to investigate mechanical force sensing in T cells, opening new avenues for immunotherapy research.

milestones.title: Moderna mRNA flu vaccine receives FDA approval
milestones.summary: Moderna's mRNA-based influenza vaccine gains FDA approval, marking the first regulatory clearance for an mRNA flu vaccine.

milestones.summary: Certify-or-decline proof-step verification raises answer-key-match precision by up to 46 percentage points on AIME-2025 and 31 on GPQA for open-weight models, though at reduced coverage (21-35%).

milestones.title: Neuro-VL: Frontier Vision-Language Model for Human Neuroimaging
milestones.summary: Researchers introduce Neuro-VL, a vision-language foundation model designed to interpret complex neuroimaging examinations and communicate findings for clinical decision-making.

milestones.title: Training-free entropy-gated decoding cuts LLM token output 25–35% with non-inferior quality
milestones.summary: A novel entropy-gated logits processor reduces token generation by up to 34.9% on MT-Bench while preserving semantic content within BERTScore non-inferiority margins.

milestones.title: Khmer PFGen-Bench: First judge-free benchmark for open-ended generation in Khmer
milestones.summary: Researchers introduce Khmer PFGen-Bench, the first judge-free benchmark for multi-sentence open-ended generation in Khmer, adapting keyword-rule and n-gram scoring from a Japanese benchmark.

milestones.title: First judge-free benchmark for open-ended Khmer generation
milestones.summary: Researchers introduce Khmer PFGen-Bench, the first judge-free benchmark for multi-sentence open-ended generation in Khmer, adapting a keyword-rule scorer from Japanese to a low-resource language.

milestones.title: MARS: Retriever-Free Multilingual Search Agents
milestones.summary: MARS introduces retriever-free multilingual search agents that directly interact with raw corpora via executable commands, eliminating reliance on learned retrievers.

milestones.title: Behavior-Conditioned Symbolic Synthesis (BCSS) scales symbolic modeling of human and machine reasoning
milestones.summary: New AI method automates search for interpretable symbolic programs that verifiably reproduce behavior, enabling scalable modeling of both human and machine reasoning.

milestones.title: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
milestones.summary: FlashOffloading introduces a host-DRAM KV cache offloading technique that reduces latency and improves concurrency for long-context LLM inference.

milestones.title: Generate-then-Rank: Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
milestones.summary: New two-stage generate-then-rank method improves symbolic goal interpretation for embodied agents using LLMs.

milestones.title: PAYWORTHY benchmark evaluates LLM predictions of AI agent success on freelance jobs
milestones.summary: Researchers introduce PAYWORTHY, a benchmark of 1,494 real freelance job postings to test whether 18 frontier LLMs can predict AI agent success before task execution.

milestones.title: Novel Method Tests AI Introspection by Injecting Thoughts into LLMs
milestones.summary: Researchers develop a technique to probe whether large language models possess genuine introspective access to their own internal states by injecting synthetic thoughts.

milestones.title: CST-Bench: New benchmark for counterfactual spatial reasoning with 7,082 examples

milestones.summary: A formal grammar-lens benchmark shows GPT-5.5 Pro variants achieve 16%, 40%, 43%, and 52% acceptance rates at increasing test-time processing levels.

milestones.title: First 1B-parameter monolingual Icelandic encoder trained on open data

milestones.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Training-Free Hallucination Correction for Multimodal LLMs
milestones.summary: A training-free framework rebalances evidence and priors in fused representations to correct cross-modal hallucinations in Omni LLMs.

milestones.title: ReuF2F: New Benchmark for Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
milestones.summary: Researchers introduce ReuF2F, a benchmark evaluating AI coding agents on formalized undergraduate research problems to improve reliable verification of mathematical reasoning.

milestones.title: AI proves Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis
milestones.summary: AI system proves the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis, a major mathematical conjecture, with human experts verifying the proof.

milestones.title: RealCLI: Unified Benchmark for Human-Agent CLI Collaboration
milestones.summary: Introduces REALCLI, a paired benchmark unifying task execution and human-agent collaboration quality evaluation for CLI agents via a five-dimensional framework.

milestones.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
milestones.summary: New recursive self-improvement framework (Self-HPO) co-evolves LLM policy models and their execution harnesses to advance autonomous coding agents.

milestones.title: EmbodiedCLBench: First benchmark for continual learning in embodied agents
milestones.summary: EmbodiedCLBench introduces the first benchmark for evaluating continual learning in embodied agents, enabling assessment of self-evolving agents in simulation.

milestones.title: CLEAT: Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive LLM Agents
milestones.summary: New training method CLEAT teaches LLM agents to ask high-value clarifying questions that improve decision-making under ambiguous user intent.

milestones.title: Few-shot multimodal representation alignment via distilled optimal transport
milestones.summary: New method aligns independently pretrained unimodal encoders using only 100-500 paired examples via optimal transport, drastically reducing paired data requirements.

milestones.title: Persistent KV cache enables 50M-token context window on single H100

milestones.title: Prefill-Only Decision Models Reduce Inference Cost by 10-100x
milestones.summary: New prefill-only decision models eliminate decoding to make single calls one to two orders of magnitude cheaper than generative language models of similar scale.

milestones.title: Format-aware fusion enables fast FP4 pretraining at 160B-token scale
milestones.summary: New format-aware fusion technique co-designs FP4 quantization producers and consumers to achieve efficient Llama-3 8B pretraining over 160B tokens using native MXFP and NVFP formats.

milestones.title: TutlAit v1: first crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels
milestones.summary: First publicly available Moroccan Tamazight speech corpus with Modern Standard Arabic transcriptions and explicit regional accent labels, collected via a dedicated crowdsourcing web application.

milestones.summary: BACKDROP introduces a new benchmark that quantifies how much agent capability degrades when everyday hazards like conflicting instructions or environmental changes are introduced during task execution

milestones.title: Tampered ML benchmark introduced for evaluating LLM judgment of ML research
milestones.summary: New benchmark Tampered ML with 1,858 item-pairs evaluates LLM ability to identify flaws in ML research proposals and assess experimental support for claims.

milestones.title: Forecast-Dojo: Replayable Benchmark for LLM Forecasting Agents
milestones.summary: Forecast-Dojo introduces a replayable environment with 1,568 Polymarket events and 18.8M tokens for benchmarking and training LLM forecasting agents using historical prediction-market data.

milestones.title: New evaluation protocol detects sequential reappearance in diffusion model unlearning
milestones.summary: Researchers identify sequential reappearance in diffusion data-point unlearning and propose a target-level evaluation protocol to track forgetting persistence across sequential deletion requests.

milestones.title: STAM: State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical LLM Agents
milestones.summary: STAM introduces a state-transition-aware memory framework enabling LLM agents to track patient state changes while preserving clinical history for improved reasoning over medical records.

milestones.summary: Seed2.0 introduces a new model series with world-leading reasoning, visual understanding, and search capabilities, improving long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following for real-world tasks.
